ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between a dominant light-grey/white internal pixel field (approx. 85-90% surface area) and a sharp black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-grey region across both lobes; bounded by a continuous, high-intensity black margin (5-15 pixels thick) following the entire trailing edge contour from left to right terminus.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 95 degrees and a vertical indentation depth approximately 1/8th of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels along the continuous black trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical lateral sweep exhibiting convex curvature along the outer trailing edge transitioning to a concave arc as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-contrast, pale circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixel diameters) distributed across the central-left and central-right ventral surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely distinct and continuous black pigmentation border tracing the entire trailing edge, contrasting sharply against the nearly uniform pale interior lobes.
